bio.text: Stephen Harding was elected to the 30th State Senate District in 2022 after four terms representing the 107th House District, and was named Senate Minority Leader in February 2024.
He graduated summa cum laude from Albertus Magnus College and earned a law degree from New York Law School, and operates his own law practice in Danbury.
He has lived in Brookfield for nearly 30 years and has served on the town's Zoning Board of Appeals and Board of Education.
